decision: Bind every Qubes qualification campaign to the exact calibrated topology and calibration evidence digest, then validate the binding before attested multi-run qualification.

reviews.reason: A selection artifact checked only before execution does not prove that later lease/recovery evidence came from the selected calibrated topology. Every campaign must carry the same topologyId and calibrationEvidenceDigest.
Reject missing, malformed, legacy, wrong, or mixed topology/digest evidence before readiness evaluation. Never overwrite conflicting provenance silently.
Adds zero qrexec round-trips, no daemon/database, negligible CPU/RAM, and does not modify MissionQueue, coordinator mutation semantics, or worker side effects.

alternatives.rejected: Does not bind raw execution evidence to the calibration set that selected the topology; stale or mixed campaign evidence can cross the handoff boundary.
Higher latency and Qube resource use, duplicates already measured work, and broadens the failure surface without improving identity binding as efficiently.

alternatives.approach: external provenance database or attestation daemon
alternatives.rejected: Adds operational state, credentials, IPC/network lifecycle, and regression surface before real Qubes execution evidence warrants that complexity.

positive: all campaign_start events carry the selected topologyId
all campaign_start events carry the exact calibrationEvidenceDigest
multiple independent recovery runs retain identical calibration binding
negative: legacy campaign missing binding fails closed
wrong or malformed digest fails closed
mixed bindings across runs fail closed
pre-existing conflicting provenance cannot be overwritten silently

lesson: Selection-time provenance is not execution-time provenance. Qualification evidence must carry the calibration identity across the handoff boundary and preserve it per run.
